name: Storm Protection Shutdown Guard
description: When wind speed exceeds cut-out threshold (b_cutout=1), the turbine must pitch to feather and reach standstill within 10 minutes. Guarded UPR: shutdown sequence applies only when b_cutout=1.

elements.name: Cut-out Condition Flag
elements.description: Binary flag: 0=below cut-out wind speed, 1=above cut-out — storm shutdown required.

uncertainty.source: IEA 15 MW turbine control system: cut-out condition from hub-height anemometer

elements.name: Maximum Shutdown Duration
elements.description: IEC 61400-1: turbine must reach standstill within 10 minutes of cut-out trigger

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(P_gen) = 0 if b_cutout=1, else P_nominal; guard activates feather-pitch and generator disconnect
consistency_relations.upr_description: Guarded UPR: storm shutdown sequence applies only when cut-out condition b_cutout=1 is active.
